name: dsh-farm
description: DSH service farm: register, start, stop, restart and watch long-running project services. A tab in the official DSH right Sidebar (a guide entry beside Files / Browser / Terminal; falls back to a footer button + drawer, or a DSH-better-sidebar tab) with per-workspace groups, live log follow, search and export; farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register tools for the agent; optional farm.yaml declaration per workspace.
